caseName: Pud No. 1 of Jefferson County v. Washington Department of Ecology
caseNameFull: PUD No. 1 of Jefferson County Et Al. v. Washington Department of Ecology Et Al.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Wash. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, November 16, 1993. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on. or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 14, 1993. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, January 5, 1994. This Court’s Rule 29 does not apply.
